body:
#

Absolute Realism **

Completely redesigned gameplay, vast beautiful world,
cinematic graphics, lots of new content, and enhancements to every game's aspect.** **** ![field cloudy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1b66758023672f2da73f951eca0603d07de1b6f.png) ![forest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df59751678ff990b841ff408ceaa61cc7e7f3f88.png) ![snowy mountains](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9fa7a63325157b7e396d6f68ae465c7526466fea.png) **** #

Important! 1. **Allocate 4-8 gigabytes of RAM for Absolute Realism.** 2. **Make sure that Options -> DH config (cube on the top left) -> CPU Load is set to Low Impact.** 3. **Important keybinds: C - crawl; Left Alt - change walk speed; X - sit.** 4. **If you see "Distant Horizons: G1 garbage collector detected" you can fix it by adding "-XX:+UseZGC" in java arguments. _Though, its not required._** 5. You can turn off VSync for slightly better performance in Options -> Video Settings -> General. **** Original source of bliss shader - https://github.com/X0nk/Bliss-Shader
